vocabulary.definition: behavior that society considers wrong or sinful
vocabulary.example: The strict laws in the country aim to prevent any form of immorality.

vocabulary.definition: prevented or forbidden from doing something
vocabulary.example: The students were barred from entering the library after hours.

vocabulary.definition: a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable
vocabulary.example: Her smile was a metaphor for sunshine on a rainy day.

vocabulary.definition: expressed disapproval of someone or something
vocabulary.example: The author was heavily criticised for the controversial ending of the novel.

vocabulary.definition: a very bad situation that is difficult or impossible to get out of
vocabulary.example: The company faced an abyss of debt that seemed insurmountable.

vocabulary.definition: one of two or more available possibilities
vocabulary.example: If this plan fails, we need to think of an alternative approach.
